Questions

What is the median annual wage for Electricians in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Electricians in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA is $101,780.

What is the hourly median for Electricians in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Electricians in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA is $48.93.

How many Electricians work in Seattle?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 9,750 wage-and-salary Electricians in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Electricians in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 0.96. Values above 1.00 mean Electricians are more concentrated in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Electricians in Seattle?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Electricians in Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA is $99,720.

How does Seattle's Electricians median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Seattle's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($101,780) is $41,390 higher than Austin ($60,390) and $570 lower than Chicago ($102,350). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
